title: scenarios: the order_to_cash card title is 131 characters, over the 128 the marketplace display name allows
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjNq58cmHeqckjZkTFE

Filing gate: ② a contract violation by a named producer, found by the os-dev of #35132 (report 7004393928) and measured by this seat.

- The producer: `docs/qa/scenarios/order_to_cash.json` `title.en` is 131 characters: "Order to cash: accounts, an activity stream, sales orders with lines, a discount approval, invoices, payments and receivables aging".
- The contract: `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts:213` `displayName: z.string().min(1).max(128)`. Since #35132 (PR #35430), the gallery exporter writes the card's `title.en` as the exported `objectstack.manifest.json` `displayName`, so that app's manifest fails `TemplateManifestSchema` (measured by the dev), and publishing it (#35134) would be refused.
- Fix: shorten `title.en` (and check `title.zh`) to 128 characters or fewer in the card. The producer is the card (contract-first); the exporter deliberately does not refuse, because refusing deletes a listed app on refresh.

Seam: spec:PackageSchema.displayName max(128) → runtime: gallery exporter listing manifest; consumer: `os package publish`.
Suggested-grade: p3 · one-line card edit; blocks only #35134's publish of this one app.
Dedupe words: order_to_cash title length, displayName 128, gallery listing name.
